text: A function f: [a,b] → ℝ is ___ if for every ε>0 there exists δ>0 such that Σ|f(xᵢ)-f(xᵢ₋₁)| < ε whenever Σ|xᵢ-xᵢ₋₁| < δ.
explanation: Absolute continuity is stronger than uniform continuity. AC ↔ f is the antiderivative of an L¹ function (fundamental theorem of calculus for Lebesgue integration).
